songs.title: We Made It Through
songs.stylePrompt: warm melodic pop, vi-IV-I-V progression, octave lift into the chorus, textured mood
songs.lyrics:
[instrumental hook]

[Verse 1]
You said the boards were hot from noon
And dared the whole crowd down the rail
Bulbs were swinging over prizes
Salt air shining on your veil
An open doorway spilled out laughter
Humid night behind our trail
Painted horses turned behind us
Prize bells rang along the rail

[Chorus]
Your hand went up, the crowd replied
We Made It Through
Every bright shop seemed to grin
The summer let us all back in
The night went wide around our shoes

[Verse 2]
You bought one soda, passed it round
Then ran ahead through neon blue
The gate was closing near the pier
Someone shouted from the photo booth

[Chorus]
Your hand went up, the crowd replied
We Made It Through
Every bright shop seemed to grin
The summer let us all back in
The night went wide around our shoes

[Final Chorus]
We Made It Through
The boardwalk bulbs came blazing wide
The gate swung open one more time
Salt on our sleeves and joy in view
We Made It Through
